T: Sometimes dead is better. Fresh is best.
D: A doctor moves his family to rural Maine and learns about the burial ground beyond the pet cemetery.
P: Serve the beers when Louis and Jud sit out on the porch.
S: beers on the porch across the road with Jud
Salted peanuts roasted in the shell, pickled onions and a wedge of sharp cheddar with crackers, laid out on an old tray for the porch.
the family cat, back but not quite right

Muffin batter of flour, sugar, buttermilk, melted butter and egg mixed briefly, fresh blueberries folded in, cinnamon crumble on top, baked at 200C for 20 minutes. Mix 300g flour, 150g sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 80g melted butter and 1 egg briefly. Fold in 200g blueberries. Spoon into a 12-hole tin, top with cinnamon crumble and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
the family picnic in the field by the road

Devilled eggs whipped with mayo, mustard and a little relish, topped with crisp shallots, paprika and chives, packed into a picnic box. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tsp mustard, 1 tbsp sweet pickle relish, salt and pepper until smooth. Pipe back into the whites. Thinly slice 2 shallots and fry in oil until golden and crisp, then drain. Top each egg with paprika, crisp shallots and snipped chives, and chill until the picnic.
M: Louis stays home alone at Thanksgiving while the family visits Chicago

Turkey breast roasted with herb butter until juicy, with cornbread stuffing, buttery mash, cranberry sauce and a rich pan gravy. Heat the oven to 180C. Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast roll with 50g butter mashed with sage, thyme and garlic and roast for 75 minutes to 70C inside, then rest 15 minutes. Mix 300g crumbled cornbread with 1 diced onion softened in butter, chopped sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock and bake for 30 minutes alongside. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter and milk. Make gravy from the tray juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock. Serve with cranberry sauce.
Molasses baked beans with ham hock, served with steamed brown bread and coleslaw. Soak 500g navy beans overnight.
W: the road out front where the trucks fly past

Apples sliced and tossed with cinnamon, sugar and lemon, covered with a crumble of oats, flour, brown sugar and cold butter, baked at 180C for 40 minutes. Toss 6 sliced apples with 1 tsp cinnamon, 60g sugar and lemon juice in a dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 80g flour, 80g oats and 80g brown sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Serve with pouring cream.
K: Jud's porch lager and apple cider shandy
Jud's cold beers on the porch

Ice-cold lager topped with sparkling apple cider and a squeeze of lemon, served in frosted glasses with a thin apple slice, easy drinking on a Maine porch. Put 4 pint glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Pour 200ml cold lager into each, then top slowly with 150ml chilled sparkling apple cider. Add a squeeze of lemon and a thin slice of green apple to each glass and serve straight away.
